lines.t: The whole hall is humming for you. That's the vines saying well done. They're not good with words.
Welcome to Rootloft Hall. The vine curtains open only for Tuners who out-sing the hall's two Tuners.
Beat one, and its curtain withers. Beat both, and Cantor Wren will hear you out.
Wren's kin are verdant, and so is this hall. Fire and gale voices fare well here. Just don't set the curtains alight.
You listened under the noise. That's rarer than winning.
Take this Keynote. It's tuned to stone. Every hall teaches the note *after* its own. That's how a chord gets built.
And this Etude — Draining Bloom. A root that drinks as it strikes. Teach it to someone patient.
Engineers in my wood with coils and clipboards. I've sent a complaint. In triplicate. They seemed pleased.
The wardens have lowered the canopy bridge for you. Brackenridge lies north. Listen for the stone under the heather.
A forest isn't loud. It's *layered*. Show me you can hear the layers.
You listened under the noise. That's rarer than winning.
Too much at once. Come back when you can hear one leaf at a time.
